spec.experiment: SG28 independent paper-inspired PA and Laplacian components
spec.baseline: frozen A3 CA, FINE-P2 SA, R2 DenseCRF; historical A3 orientation caveat retained
spec.ca: selected 11 modules, calls 0-30, all heads, class-word W, A3 pseudo-global weights
spec.sa: module 15 at 64x64, calls 10-20 inclusive, all eight heads, two observation-wise passes

pa.P1: weighted Q-norm centering, SVD Procrustes K to Q, uncentered K rotated for attention
pa.P2: weighted Q-norm centering only, Qc Kc attention
pa.P3: uniform centering, SVD Procrustes K to Q, uncentered K rotated for attention

laplacian.grayscale: 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B, image divided by 255, area downsampled to 64x64
laplacian.solver_note: maximum iterations is an accuracy guard, not a tuned model parameter

spec.selection: five fixed VOC folds, raw and R2 screens, forced OOF per cell, 17-threshold grid; frozen COCO only
spec.storage: atomic per-image metric/diagnostic checkpoints; no generated images, masks or attention maps retained

fixed_threshold_changes.stage: raw normalized score maps before R2
